assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent toy ball sprite for a hand-painted puppy care game. Reference image: the approved puppy, use its soft detailed painterly fur and moss-green cloth vest only as visual quality, palette and lighting reference. Draw exactly ONE complete round soft fabric play ball, with alternating muted moss-green and warm ivory curved sewn panels. Show the full spherical silhouette with no cropping, visible tasteful hand stitching along curved seams, tiny felt/yarn fibers, subtle worn fabric texture, warm dimensional brush-painted shading and a soft small highlight. The ball must feel like a beautifully illustrated physical puppy toy, not a flat vector circle, plastic sphere, emoji or UI icon. Three-quarter panel arrangement gives clear rotation landmarks. Square transparent canvas; ball centered at (50%,50%), occupies about 72% of canvas width and height, generous fully transparent margin all around. No puppy, paws, human, ground plane, cast shadow, pedestal, props, motion lines, text, logo, labels, background or painted checkerboard. Preserve true alpha transparency. Consistent warm light from upper left; calm olive/cream colors with clear mobile-scale readability.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent 3x3 atlas of NINE distinct bite-size dog-game food illustrations. Reference: the puppy image is STYLE reference only, match its beautifully detailed soft hand-painted warm shading and cute mobile-game clarity. No puppy in output. Equal square cells, ONE isolated food object per cell, centered exactly at each cell center, each object entirely within its cell with 20% transparent padding. No cell borders, labels, text, checkerboard or ground shadows. Genuine alpha background. All food is small single bite-size pet treats, not bowls or plates, no packaging, no humans, no chocolate/grapes/bones with sharp edges. Top row left-to-right: 1 a round golden oat biscuit with tiny round indentations; 2 three small curved orange pumpkin crisps together; 3 a cute carrot-shaped baked biscuit with a small green baked detail. Middle row left-to-right: 4 a small folded strip of golden cooked chicken jerky; 5 three soft coral-pink boneless salmon bite cubes; 6 two creamy ivory yogurt-drop treats. Bottom row left-to-right: 7 a beautiful golden star-shaped celebration biscuit with a tiny ivory icing star, no sprinkles or writing; 8 a cluster of three deep warm-brown freeze-dried beef cubes; 9 a hand-made heart-shaped cream and honey biscuit with gentle piped edge detail. Keep food rounded, appetizing and recognizable at 32px. Rich real brush texture, soft volume, natural matte surfaces, no plastic rendering or flat icon shapes. All NINE items distinct, consistent scale and lighting, completely independent and unclipped.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent 3-column by 2-row atlas of SIX distinct puppy-game toys. Reference 1 puppy: use only painting quality, warmth and moss/ivory palette. Reference 2 stitched ball: match its textile detail and hand-painted shading. No puppy or hands. Six equal cells in a square image (each cell width 1/3 canvas, height 1/2 canvas). Exactly one isolated complete toy per cell, centered at regular cell centers. Generous clear alpha margins, entire toy inside its own cell. Top row left-to-right: 1 short sage-and-ivory braided cotton tug rope with rounded knots at both ends, arranged horizontally; 2 warm ochre fuzzy tennis ball with an ivory curved seam; 3 cute soft pale-yellow squeaky rubber duck with muted rust-orange beak, matte painted texture. Bottom row left-to-right: 4 a muted dusty-blue stuffed star toy with tiny sewn eyes and obvious fabric seams; 5 a terracotta and cream rounded flying disc with a simple embossed paw motif in center, perspective slightly tilted, no words; 6 a moss-green and cream round treat-puzzle ball with three small rounded openings and one visible golden treat inside. Texture and depth must match the beautiful original ball and puppy illustration, not flat SVG icons or shiny plastic. Ball toys round, rope genuinely braided, plush star visibly soft. No text, labels, grid, outlines between cells, backgrounds, cast shadows, extra props, collars or treats outside the puzzle ball. Real alpha transparency and no checkerboard painted into image.

usage: Original transparent images embedded as native Rive UV cutouts; no bitmap editing. Item UV crops are defined in backend/pet_care.py.
